# Introduction {.unnumbered}

Math & Programming Camp is designed to refresh mathematical concepts
and introduce statistical programming that Ph.D. students will use in
their research. It starts with an intensive week-long course followed
by weekly Methods Brown Bag sessions (more details will be provided on
the last day of the camp). This course reintroduces students to basic
topics in probability, linear algebra, and calculus through lectures,
problem sets, and homework assignments, while also teaching the
statistical software packages and workflow management skills needed
for data-driven research.
